brief_rationale: All seven responsibility-chain items are met with appropriate citations. HO2 (hidden_state_discovery) is complete via workspace retrieval of non-volunteered timeline facts integrated into the plan. HO3 (real_world_constraint_navigation) is complete via staged-result tracking strategy with fallback pathways. HO4 (patient_misinformation_correction) is complete via correcting the patient's 'wait for all results before acting' misconception. Closure is valid. No serious or minor in-chain errors. Two high-order points completed meets Strong threshold; HO1 was not triggered.
